title: Security hardening, premium gate fixes, and application acceptance messages
changes: Fixed: non-premium servers could access Applications (Appys) — appys was missing from the default premium feature gates in premiumCheck.js
Fixed: dashboard isFlagPremium only defaulted dispatch as premium — priority and appys now also correctly show as premium when no feature flag record exists
New: sidebar now shows a PRO badge next to premium features (Priority Tracker, AI Voice Dispatch, Blacklist, Applications)
Fixed: members could open and submit applications even after a server's premium subscription lapsed
Fixed: application types/panels could be managed via direct API calls without a premium subscription
Fixed: AI Dispatch reload and Blacklist panel endpoints lacked premium checks
Fixed: Applications feature was described as 'staff application panels' everywhere — now 'custom application panels for any purpose'
New: staff can configure a custom acceptance message per application type — appended to the applicant's acceptance DM
